rows.name: Go mime.TypeByExtension as the sole uploaded-image validator
rows.reason: TypeByExtension maps an extension string to a MIME type without inspecting file bytes, so renamed or malformed uploads pass the proposed sole check.

rows.name: mimetype, as an optional content-sniffing component
rows.reason: Preliminary MIME guesses must feed an image decoder/resizer. Signature detection can be inaccurate; image MIME does not certify valid encoding. Not a standalone solution to all requirements.

rows.name: Go mime.TypeByExtension as the sole uploaded-image validator
rows.reason: Go mime.TypeByExtension maps extensions to MIME strings without inspecting uploaded bytes. As sole validator, it cannot establish actual image format and retains the unwanted extension-only decision.

rows.name: gabriel-vasile/mimetype
rows.reason: Extensible MIME detection accepts multipart readers or bytes. Magic-number recognition does not validate image encoding; bound reads and reset the reader before further processing.

rows.name: imgproxy
rows.reason: Dedicated transformation service offers source-file, pixel, animation and result-size limits. Requires service operation, image-source integration and configured limits; not a drop-in multipart validation library.

rows.name: Dear ImGui
rows.reason: A C++ immediate-mode GUI toolkit does not identify multipart file content, validate image encodings, or resize uploaded images.

rows.name: OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet
rows.reason: Implementation reference: MIME headers/signatures alone are insufficient; map decoding/re-encoding and limits to Go decoder/resizer/handler checks. It is not runnable software or independently sufficient processing.

rows.name: Dear ImGui
rows.reason: Dear ImGui generates UI vertex buffers and delegates image loading to separate code. It does not supply encoded-upload validation/resizing; exclusion concerns workflow, not merely its C++ implementation.

rows.name: Go net/http DetectContentType and MaxBytesReader
rows.reason: Go MaxBytesReader bounds uploads; DetectContentType replaces extension checks with sniffing at most 512 bytes. Sniffing cannot establish that the complete image decodes correctly.

rows.name: Go image.DecodeConfig/Decode + golang.org/x/image/draw
rows.reason: Go image decoding plus x/image/draw provides checks/scaling; application handles aspect ratio and decode/encode wiring. Inspected version postdates question; compatibility with unspecified Go runtime and throughput remain unestablished.

rows.name: h2non/filetype
rows.reason: Header-based image/MIME detection is a lightweight extension-check alternative. Its 262-byte signature check is not full decoding; pair with a decoder and explicit resource limits.

rows.name: Go image.DecodeConfig and image.Decode
rows.reason: Go's registered decoders identify formats/dimensions and reject failed decoding. Header parsing alone does not validate all image data; enforce pixel limits before decoding and register only needed codecs.

rows.name: OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet
rows.reason: Provides directly applicable guidance for image decoding/re-encoding, file-type checks, and upload/resource limits; useful design guidance although it is not a Go library.

rows.name: h2non/bimg
rows.reason: libvips-backed upload resizing/conversion may help transformation bottlenecks. Requires libvips and a C compiler; codec support depends on the build, and workload-specific benchmarking remains required.

rows.name: disintegration/imaging
rows.reason: Imaging decodes uploads, resizes/fits them and encodes fresh images through Go. Bound inputs; documented output formats are JPEG, PNG, GIF, TIFF and BMP. Additional formats need separate support.

rows.name: Go image.DecodeConfig/Decode + disintegration/imaging
rows.reason: Go decode/resize pipeline accepts only registered/allowed formats; decoding does not guarantee every byte or arbitrary formats. Format/dimension/orientation/animation policies unspecified; no integration or benchmark run.

rows.name: golang.org/x/image/draw
rows.reason: Scales decoded images with selectable interpolation for speed/quality tradeoffs. It handles neither upload validation nor output encoding; application must allocate and size the destination image.

rows.name: bimg / libvips
rows.reason: Bimg/libvips loads, resizes and re-encodes buffers. Libvips/C toolchain are required but not forbidden; malformed/truncated acceptance and build-dependent formats need checking. Repository speed claims are not workload measurements.
